patches.description: Add open-source Vast branding and isolated Windows product identity.
Rebaseline two upstream x64 TLBs with the supported public Windows SDK 10.0.26100.7705 MIDL.
Embed the Vast multi-resolution icon in the native Windows executable and browser resource DLL.
Register chrome://vast with a profile-scoped native controller and bundled TypeScript WebUI resources.
Connect chrome://vast to the browser process through a typed, profile-scoped Mojo runtime-info handler.
Add an asynchronous read-only schema preview for copied Vast data fixtures and expose non-sensitive counts through Mojo.
Resolve Electron data-root.json inside the native preview service while keeping configured source paths out of WebUI.
Add a native Chromium unit-test target for bounded Vast data parsing and data-root resolution.
Add a copy-first native migration transaction with allowlisted product data, SHA-256 verification, journaled commit, and non-destructive rollback.
Expose the native transaction to chrome://vast only through opt-in development switches, explicit confirmation, pathless Mojo results, and tested rollback controls.
Add a bounded native .vastbackup v1 verifier that checks ZIP structure, manifest, CRC/SHA-256, extracts only Vast product data, and feeds the existing transaction.
Add an aggregate-only native backup audit executable that removes its temporary extracted product data before returning.
Feed a pre-authorized .vastbackup fixture through aggregate preview and the existing pathless Mojo commit/rollback transaction.
Add a bounded read-only projection for workspace identity and a safe appearance/layout settings subset without exposing tabs, URLs, history, notes, or secrets.
Persist a profile-local Vast 2 product-root selection and recover only a checksum-verified committed migration with its safety backup after restart.
Activate, project, recover, and roll back the selected Vast 2 root through pathless typed Mojo, including recovery after a real browser-process restart.
Move recovered product-data state into an early-registered profile-scoped keyed service shared by all Vast WebUI controllers.
Make chrome://vast the regular-profile New Tab surface, apply the Vast palette to native browser chrome, and render safe workspace/settings state in the product dashboard.
Add a persistent native Vast workspace chip to Chromium's toolbar, backed by validated profile-scoped product state and normal top-level navigation.
Add restart-safe profile-local workspace selection through native toolbar and WebUI controls without modifying imported Vast product data.
Map validated Vast workspaces to browser-window-scoped native Chromium tab groups with safe current-session switching and automatic tab assignment.
Persist journal-scoped URL-free native group identity, restore exact workspace groups across process restarts, and harden tab-observer and WebUI accessibility lifecycles.
Persist a URL-free workspace-relative active-tab position, reconcile Chromium-remapped group tokens after session restore, and flush crash-safe native session snapshots.
